name: LiqPay API 3.0 (v2)
description: LiqPay payment gateway integration (checkout, server callback, subscriptions).
project_description:
This module provides a Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) payment method to embed the payment services provided by LiqPay API v3.0 .

 By installing the Liqpay payment API module, you will be able to accept payments on the site using:

 
 Visa and MasterCard debit, credit and corporate cards 
 Internet bank Privat24 
 Payment by QR code 
 Apple Pay 
 Google Pay 
 Payment in cash at the terminal 
 Email account 
 
 

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) 
 
 Back to top 

 Setup 
 
 After installation, go to the payment systems settings page /admin/basket/settings-payment . 
 Create a payment point and indicate in the service "LiqPay". 
 After you create, you will have a button to go to the settings page of the payment gateway itself. Or you can follow the link /admin/config/development/liqpay . 
 The module can also work in test mode.
